name: Shields
description: Concrete shield forms with independent rarity and materials

fields.description: A compact hand shield suited to deflection and close exchanges.
A balanced circular shield useful across many fighting styles.
A long tapered shield that protects the bearer’s torso and leading leg.
A compact triangular shield shaped for mounted or foot combat.
A sturdy round shield strapped close to the forearm for active defense.
A tall shield that prioritizes broad personal coverage.
A large shield built to provide stable cover, especially for ranged fighters.
A responsive shield balanced for quick defense in close combat.
An ingenious shield designed to change profile for transport or battle.
A polished shield with a reflective face whose significance is left to the GM.
A distinctive shield associated with steadfast protection.
A remarkable shield carrying stormlike motifs without a predetermined enchantment.
A singular shield bearing eclipse imagery and an intentionally undefined legacy.
A renowned shield tied to an oath whose bearer and terms remain open.
